messages:
maya: Heads up - platform team onboarding next week. We need a clear pattern for handing over the operator token set so product teams don't accidentally escalate privileges. Short-term vs long-term?

anna: Short answer: start with a shadow/monitor-only handover, not full promotion. Avoid giving product-facing service accounts the full operator scope.

luis: Agreed. Standardize delegation path: operator -> delegation-service -> tenant/service token. Central audit/revoke.

maya: So create a delegation service that mints short-lived tokens on request?

anna: Yes. Minted tokens <=1h, bound to caller identity and audience, and logged. Audit logs: requesting principal, requested scopes, original operator key id.

luis: Example mint request:

POST /v1/delegate-token
{
  "requestor": "svc-platform-x",
  "aud": "svc-foo",
  "scopes": ["read:configs"],
  "ttl": 3600
}

maya: For migration, do phased rollout where platform calls delegation endpoint while we mirror logs and still allow original operator checks.

anna: Phases: (1) observe-only (mirror logs), (2) warn-mode (warnings + telemetry), (3) enforce-mode (reject direct operator usage for tenant ops).

ops-bot: Deploy bot: canary rollout of delegation-service v0.1 scheduled for 2024-11-02 02:00 UTC. :robot_face:

tom: Nitty-gritty: aud enforcement needs to be in every downstream verifier or tokens can be replayed.

luis: Also rotate existing long-lived operator keys: keep old ones in a zombie list for rollback, then revoke after TTL. Need rotation runbook.

maya: RBAC mapping: map operator scopes to minimal RBAC roles with policy templates so teams don't request wildcards.

anna: Policy template example:

role: infra-reader
permissions: ["read:deployments", "read:configs"]
allowed_audiences: ["svc-monitoring", "svc-console"]

anna: Encourage templated requests. Admin access requires justification + approval.

maya: Who owns migration checklist? I can coordinate rollout but need eng-security reviewer for enforcement gate.

luis: I can review enforcement gate and write verifier libs (node/python/golang).

anna: I'll draft runbook, audit queries, and a short-lived-key rotation script (ansible/playbook).

tom: Telemetry: add metrics delegate_requests_total, delegate_failures, token_usage_by_aud, alert on unexpected aud usage spikes.

ops-bot: Incident bot: new alert rule proposed: "unexpected-aud-usage" - triage if >50 anomalous requests in 5m.

maya: Action items:
- maya: coordinate migration schedule and communicate to product teams.
- anna: runbook + audit queries (due EOD +3).
- luis: verifier libs + delegation service PR (due +7).
- tom: telemetry dashboards and alerts (due +5).

luis: Open question: should delegation tokens include a signed claim tying back to original operator key id? Easier audit/revocation.

anna: Yes include orig_key_id and an opaque trace id. Keep claim names stable.

maya: Proceeding. I'll announce to product leads and set first milestone for observe-only. :thumbsup:

tom: ack.

luis: ack.

anna: ack.

ops-bot: Reminder: please file a follow-up RFC for enforcement-mode policy changes and link it here.

maya: Will do - I'll post RFC draft in #eng-security next week and @luis @anna for review.
